what_was_done: Made the spec, the code and the checker say one thing about the bare /vsdd, taking the finding's preferred option. caller.py: the program alternative of _CALL_TEXT_RE is now (?:vsdd|(?:[A-Za-z0-9_./][A-Za-z0-9_@%+:,./-]*)?/vsdd) — the character run before the final /vsdd is optional, so the bare /vsdd, a path of safe characters that begins with / and holds no =, is accepted, as the spec's program rule already read; the code comment states the rule and the reason (an ordinary absolute path in sh, bash, dash and zsh, exactly like the //vsdd that was already accepted). Exactly what was wrong with the regex: it demanded one character strictly before the final /vsdd, a rule the spec does not state, refusing /vsdd survey while accepting the same program as //vsdd survey. test_caller.py: _checker_program_word follows the spec sentence by sentence now — the len(word) <= 5 rule and its docstring sentence are gone, the first-character class is checked on the word and the = check runs over the whole head, so the empty head of /vsdd is admitted; /vsdd survey joined ALLOWED_CALLS and DIFFERENTIAL_BASES; the differential test gained the deletion arm the confirmation used (deleted, inserted and replacing text at every index), and its docstring cites the finding. caller-identity.md's program bullet now says outright that the path may be the bare /vsdd, so the unstated length rule cannot quietly return. spec_lint.py: 0 problem(s). Re-ran the differential: over all 112 base and table rows with every deletion, insertion and replacement at every index, 578,600 texts, plus 300,000 random texts over all of ASCII, the quote and the controls — 0 disagreements between the regular expression and the checker, where the confirmation found 283 (all with program /vsdd). Re-ran the mutation battery in a scratch copy of next/ (restored byte-identically after each run): 114 mutations — every quoted-span widening per code point plus the single quote (34), the program first and rest classes each widened with the excluded characters, the quote and = (48), narrowings dropping one character from each class (16), the head-required pre-fix program revert and the path-form-only variant (2), separator + to star and CR/LF/FF/VT (5), pads widened with CR and LF (2), the three look-ahead drops (3), _SAFE widened with $, ( and " (3), and the raw-text gate relaxed from fullmatch to match (1) — and every one fails at least one test of test_caller.py. The pre-fix regex revert fails on the /vsdd survey rows of the allowed table and the differential, so the pin now sits on the spec's side. The widening admits only texts the spec already admitted: a program word of safe characters, no =, led by a letter, digit, _, . or /, which the parsed second gate then judges as before.
where: next/plugins/vsdd-factory/py/vsdd/hooks/caller.py (_CALL_TEXT_RE program alternative, comment); next/tests/hooks/test_caller.py (_checker_program_word; ALLOWED_CALLS and DIFFERENTIAL_BASES with /vsdd survey; test_grammar_checker_agrees_with_the_allow_list deletion arm); rewrite/spec/topics/caller-identity.md (program bullet, bare /vsdd)
